messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-07-21] standup/ember/2025-07-21: Ember runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-07-30] standup/atlas/2025-07-30: Team change: Tomasz leaves team Atlas and joins team Dune, effective today. On-call for Atlas passes from Tomasz to Priya with the move.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-05-29] standup/boreal/2025-05-29: For anything Boreal-related, page Marcus.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20: Marcus moves from team Boreal to the Atlas team today. On-call for Boreal passes from Marcus to Lena with the move.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-05-22] standup/boreal/2025-05-22: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14-2: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.
- [2025-09-05] standup/cinder/2025-09-05: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-4: The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-09-04] standup/dune/2025-09-04: Tomasz Nowak picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-3: Heads-up from the Dune team: the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-2: The Dune team noticed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
